question: The famous Pushkar Fair of Rajasthan is held _______ in a year.
solution:
The correct answer is__** one time.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The famous P**ushkar Fair of Rajasthan is held one time in a year.**
 
• Pushkar Fair is also known as **Pushkar Camel Fair or locally Kartik Fair.**
 
• It is held in the **Pushkar city of Ajmer district of Rajasthan.**
 
• The Pushkar Fair is one of the **largest camel, horse, and cattle fairs in India.**
 
• Apart from the cattle trade, it is an important pilgrimage for Hindus to Pushkar Lake.
 
• Cultural events and competitions at this fair include dancing, the tussle between female teams as well as male teams, "Matka bust", "longest mustache" contest, "bridal contest", camel race, and others.
 
• **This fair is held every year in October-November.**
